Its length and recomputed digest matched the claim, and full comparison with the standard file ruled out an additional header, omitted exhibit or different ending in this plaintext.

challenge.method: Checked the two raw SPDX paths and their common commit separately. Compared each complete ASCII plaintext without normalization. Scanned the publisher and standard SPDX bodies from the beginning to find their first mismatch, then checked the length difference and every remaining byte after the candidate insertion.
challenge.results: Both SPDX files matched through EOF. Their first 1,282 bytes matched Mozilla. In section 1.7 the SPDX files contained 0x20 immediately before a line feed where Mozilla proceeded directly to the line feed. The complete suffixes then matched, including the final newline. Trimming trailing whitespace would conceal the only difference.

limitations: The raw URLs establish commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. Its association with release 3.29.0 comes from the supplied snapshot identification. The six originals include no separate release-tag record.
